results.title: President Director Rudi and Commissioner Prijono Sugiarto of PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) buy additional shares, spending IDR 21.14 billion and IDR 42.20 million respectively
results.body: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) disclosed that President Director Rudi purchased 2,200,000 shares on 21 September 2026 at IDR 4,820 per share and another 2,200,000 shares on 22 September 2026 at IDR 4,790 per share, totaling an outlay of approximately IDR 21.14 billion. The purchases raised Rudi’s holding from 1.2 million to 5.6 million shares, giving him a voting right of 0,0138%. Member of the Board of Commissioners Prijono Sugiarto bought 8,700 shares on 21 September 2026 at IDR 4,850 per share for about IDR 42.20 million, increasing his stake from 5,587,100 to 5,595,800 shares while his voting right remained at 0,0138%. Both transactions were reported to the Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) as investment purchases.

results.title: Morgan Stanley & Co International Plc raises its stake in PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) to over 7%
results.body: Morgan Stanley & Co International Plc purchased an additional 400 million shares of PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) at Rp27 per share on 18 September 2026, raising its holding to 80.94 billion shares or 7.03% of GOTO’s equity. The transaction, valued at roughly Rp10.8 billion, is recorded as a non‑controlling shareholding. The purchase occurs as GOTO seeks shareholder approval to cancel about 32.18 billion treasury shares, representing 80.89% of its treasury stock, and continues its buyback program with a maximum allocation of Rp3.5 trillion for 2026-2027. The reduction in outstanding shares is expected to increase GOTO’s earnings per share, assuming net profit remains unchanged.

results.title: Technical buy recommendations for PT Barito Pacific Tbk (BRPT), PT MAP Aktif Adiperkasa Tbk (MAPA) and PT AKR Corporindo Tbk (AKRA)
results.body: The article issues technical stock recommendations for PT Barito Pacific Tbk (BRPT), PT MAP Aktif Adiperkasa Tbk (MAPA) and PT AKR Corporindo Tbk (AKRA) for 23 September 2026. BRPT closed at Rp 1,620, up 3.51% daily, with Stochastics K_D and RSI indicating oversold conditions; Mirae Asset Sekuritas recommends a Speculative Buy with support at Rp 1,545 and resistance at Rp 1,670. MAPA closed at Rp 680, down 2.16%, showing a hammer candlestick and MACD golden cross; BCA Sekuritas advises a Trading Buy with support at Rp 620 and resistance at Rp 820. AKRA closed at Rp 1,460, up 0.69%, staying above its 200‑day moving average and retesting a Fibonacci support zone; BRI Danareksa Sekuritas recommends a Buy on Weakness with support at Rp 1,420 and resistance at Rp 1,550, while the IHSG index rebounded 1.56% to 6,374.91 points.

results.title: MNC Sekuritas forecasts IHSG rise and recommends top-performing stocks on 24 Sep 2026
results.body: MNC Sekuritas noted that the IHSG closed up 1.56% at 6,374.91 on 23 Sep 2026 and projected the index to test support levels 6,208-6,258 before targeting a near-term strength zone of 6,387-6,418, with support at 6,267 and 6,108 and resistance at 6,440-6,535. The LQ45 gainers were PT Indika Energy Tbk (INDY) (+10.04%), PT Darma Henwa Tbk (DEWA) (+9.20%) and PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk (MDKA) (+8.83%), with additional advances from PT Hartadinata Abadi Tbk (HRTA) (+5.99%), PT Bumi Resources Tbk (BUMI) (+4.89%) and PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk (MBMA) (+3.96%). The biggest decliners were PT Charoen Pokphand Indonesia Tbk (CPIN) (-1.91%), PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (TLKM) (-1.21%), PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk (PGAS) (-1.03%), PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) (-0.63%), PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk (EMTK) (-0.45%) and PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk (ITMG) (-0.40%). The broker recommended buying on weakness PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (EMAS) and PT Vktr Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk (VKTR), and buying PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk (CUAN) and PT Indika Energy Tbk (INDY).

results.title: CreditSights maintains Underperform rating on senior bonds of PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI) and PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk (BBNI) amid KDMP credit risk
results.body: CreditSights kept its Underperform view on the senior bonds of PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI) and PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk (BBNI), noting that the bonds trade at only 100 bps and 68 bps above US Treasury yields respectively—well below the 25‑30 bps fair‑value spread to comparable Indian bank bonds—while each bank has extended Rp 55 trillion to PT Agrinas Pangan Nusantara (Agrinas) for the government‑backed KDMP program, representing 3 % of BMRI’s gross loan book and 6 % of BBNI’s. The firm highlighted the resulting pressure on capital ratios (CET1 of 16.7 % for BMRI and 15.7 % for BBNI, with projected reductions of roughly 25 bps and 43 bps) and net interest margins (KDMP loan NIM 2.2 % versus overall NIM 4.4 % for BMRI and 3.6 % for BBNI).

results.title: Popular News Roundup: PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) Schedules Extraordinary General Meeting, Gold Jewelry Prices Diverge, and Other Market Updates
results.body: PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) called an extraordinary general meeting for 14 October 2026, where shareholders will consider a treasury‑share buy‑back capital reduction and the resignation of deputy CEO Catherine Hindra Sutjahyo, while gold jewelry prices fell and Hartadinata Abadi (HRTA) and Laku Emas remained stable, highlighting market volatility. Belvin Tannadi sold his entire 76,784,700‑share (11.54%) stake in PT Bekasi Asri Pemula Tbk (BAPA) at IDR 145 per share on 22 September 2026, citing a cut‑loss motive.
